title: Does the LLC track attention-head specialization? An outside replication of refined-LLC head differentiation

original_idea.body:
# Does the LLC Track Head Specialization?

Compute per-head refined LLC and ablation-based specialization over training; test alignment of onset.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: developmental interp for predicting dangerous-capability formation but the safety-outcome link is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Refined per-head LLC plus ablation metrics on a transformer needs solid ML/theory; intermediate.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused replication comparing LLC vs ablation onset; breadth from checkpointing/dual metrics.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected independent replication of a single-group developmental-interp result, open tooling, strong external value.

low_compute.reasoning: Small transformer plus SGLD LLC chains, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Refined-LLC specialization is from one group; an independent replication with ablation cross-check may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Single-group result; independent replication may be open.
